name: Метки
handoff: Create a UTF-8 JSON template with string field values. The user opens it via Действия → Открыть файл, reviews it, then presses Записать on Android Chrome with NFC. The browser requires the user's gesture and NFC permission. There is no remote tag-writing API.
privacy: Tag data and imported templates stay on the user's device. Do not include credentials in example templates or URLs.
